language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi, my name is Punchau. I am an Inca boy from South America, from a very long time ago.
I am going to need your help to create the walls of a temple. Behind me is an ancient temple.
In order to build a temple we need a lot of stones. We need hundreds and thousand of them. A number in the thousands is a 4 digit number.
If you look beside me, there are four stacks of bricks. Each of them is a part of a 4 digit number. Each of them has a place value.
The place values, from left to right are: thousands, hundreds, tens and ones. The number is four thousand, two hundred and thirty one.
Do you see the llama behind me? Llamas bring supplies into the cities where the temples are.
Each of their packs could contain a large number of items, such as coins, grains or other food supplies.
For example, this pack contains one thousand eight hundred gold coins. That is a 4 digit number: 1800.
Did you notice that there are some unfinished temples in the background? Let’s take a look to see what needs to be built.
